question: What type of forest resources are found in the Arabadi forest range which is considered to be the best example of conservation in West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sal.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sal Tree**

 
 
• Sal trees are evergreen trees that are native to the Indian subcontinent.
 
• In the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, and Jharkhand** in the north of India, this tree is known as the **Sakhua tree.**
 
• The most distinctive characteristic of this Sal's tree is its suitability for a wide range of natural habitats, including **9 cm to 500 cm** of **annual rainfall **and temperatures as extreme as **hot and cold.**
 
• Most of the time, it grows very slowly; **between 10 and 15 plants**, only one survives, and others die for a variety of reasons.
 
• This tree typically lives between **19 and 40 years,** but because so much furniture is made out of it now, it can **live for 15 to 25 years.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arabari forest**

 
 
• ​The Arabari Forest Range is adjacent to the Dalma range in East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, and is** 35 kilometers from Mednipore.**
 
• The town of Midnapore is **30 kilometers** from the **range's center.**
 
• Sal** (Shorea Robusta) **is the forest's most common tree.
